column1: # Models for picture_test.slurm. Tab-separated: key, server alias, Hugging Face repository,
# pinned revision, weights file, its SHA-256, projector file, its SHA-256, folder under
# POD_LLM_RUNTIME. "." for 12b is where setup_12b.sh puts the 12B files. e2b is the
# E2B file pair used on the CPU since 2026-10-13 (projector Q8_0); e2b-bf16 is the same
# weights with the BF16 projector of the same repository; the others are Google QAT
# Q4_0 builds with BF16 projectors. e2b vs e2b-bf16 isolates the projector, e2b-bf16
